services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: Wednesday, September 2 Stickley Museum - Craftsman Farms Campus Arrive 12:00 noon - Introduction and lunch, followed by a visit to the Education Center, a museum tour with Jonathan Clancy, Executive Director, time to walk the grounds, and visit the gift shop. Overnight reservations at Debary Inn, in Summit, NJ. Dinner in a private dining room at a local restaurant. Craftsman Farms webpage: https://www.stickleymuseum.org/ Thursday, September 3 Breakfast complimentary at the Debary Inn. Arrive by 10:30am at Greenwood Gardens, an example of an Arts & Crafts garden, tour garden and house (a 1951 colonial revival), many 1911 original buildings, and Rookwood pottery.
